item.title: asterisk: drop 21, 20.18.2 -> 20.21.0, 22.8.2 -> 22.11.0, 23.2.2 -> 23.5.0
item.description:
Manual backport of #577687 to release-26.05.

Fixes #579709 (CVE-2026-57193, LDAP filter injection in res_config_ldap, GHSA-r6c2-hwc2-j4mp). Upstream fixed it in 20.20.1, 21.12.3, 22.10.1 and 23.4.1; release-26.05 currently ships 20.18.2, 22.8.2 and 23.2.2, which are all vulnerable. master is already fixed by #577687.

Changes (cherry-picked as-is with -x):

  • asterisk_20: 20.18.2 -> 20.21.0 (asterisk-stable)
  • asterisk_22: 22.8.2 -> 22.11.0 (asterisk, asterisk-lts, asterisk-ldap)
  • asterisk_23: 23.2.2 -> 23.5.0
  • bundled pjproject: 2.15.1 -> 2.17
  • asterisk 21 (EOL 2026-10-18) dropped from the version set. On release-26.05 it was never exposed in all-packages.nix, so I wouldn't consider this a breaking change. Keeping it would require another pjsip version.

  • https://github.com/asterisk/asterisk/releases/tag/20.21.0
